---
name: Skill request
about: You'd use a skill Maximus doesn't have yet.
title: '[skill request] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: MacroTechTitan
---

## The procedure

Describe the procedure you're currently doing manually. Walk through the
steps as if teaching a new hire on day one.

## Why a generic model can't do this

What are the specific gotchas a generic LLM would miss? What have you
seen models get wrong when you tried to do this with just prompting?

## The output you want back

What does a good deliverable from this skill look like? Length, structure,
tone, sections?

## When you've done this in real work

Have you personally used this procedure? On what kind of work? How often?

## Related existing skills

Is there an existing Maximus skill that partially covers this? What
would this skill do that the existing one doesn't?

## Anything else

Adjacent skills you'd expect it to pair with, tools it should assume
access to, models it should work best with.
